principle: Paper 8.5 qualifies logical memory plans; Paper 4.5 realizes the frozen plans without changing selection.

evidence_levels.discovery: repeat-qualified development sequences; no product profile claim
evidence_levels.confirmation: frozen policy on held-out ordered issue sequences with sequence-clustered intervals
evidence_levels.transfer: confirmation repeated across at least two model families and two agent implementations
evidence_levels.runtime_qualified: transfer policy realized by a Paper 4.5 engine that passes PRA-100 parity, sparse-KV identity, and lifecycle gates

profile_candidates.purpose: maximize saving under a strict quality-preservation objective
profile_candidates.selection_rule: choose a nondominated frozen policy in the 30-50% failure-aware saving target region with zero point-estimate official-resolution loss and a lower 95% ordered-sequence-clustered quality-delta bound of at least -0.02
required_conditions: confirmation evidence before naming a default

profile_candidates.purpose: reduce cost per resolved issue while preserving most baseline capability
profile_candidates.selection_rule: choose the highest-saving nondominated frozen policy, preferably in the 30-50% target region, whose lower 95% ordered-sequence-clustered quality-delta bound is at least -0.05
required_conditions: positive failure-aware saving versus both persistent FULL and the relevant fresh-session control
successful-run calls increase by no more than 10%
confirmation evidence before naming a default

profile_candidates.purpose: maximize resource reduction under an explicit capability budget
profile_candidates.selection_rule: choose the highest-saving nondominated frozen policy whose lower 95% sequence-clustered quality-delta bound is at least -0.10
required_conditions: at least 50% failure-aware saving versus persistent FULL, or explicit disclosure that no qualified target-region profile exists
quality loss and fallback rate are disclosed as service-level tradeoffs
confirmation evidence before naming a default

developer: calls to solution on joint successes
it_management: quality confidence interval and evidence level

prohibitions: do not promote from frozen action agreement alone
do not pool independent, related, and dependent sequence strata
do not count early failed termination as saving
do not rename an adaptively tuned policy as confirmatory evidence
do not attribute logical token saving to native KV or latency improvement
